slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly informed

reading two sides

read the same news story from two outlets that disagree with each other. you'll understand the story, and the way it's told, far better than most people.

listening to lectures

replace one podcast a week with a free university lecture on something new. an hour with a real expert teaches you more than a whole month of hot takes ever could.

one lesson a day

spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in a field you know nothing about: geography, economics, art history. small daily doses add up to a remarkably informed mind.

slides.texte_overlay:
visiting archives

visit a local archive or library history room once a month. old newspapers and letters show you how people actually lived, not how they're remembered.

asking how it's made

pick one everyday object a week and find out exactly how it's made. you'll slowly start understanding the hidden systems behind everything you use and buy.
